description:
Set among the quiet orchards and terracotta tracks of San Lorenzo, this newly built six-bedroom villa channels the unhurried soul of rural Ibiza with rare architectural conviction. 
Thick whitewashed walls, timber-beamed ceilings and hand-selected fixtures speak to the island's vernacular tradition, while the generous scale of the interiors — flowing living rooms, a sophisticated library gallery, a dedicated dining room, a wine cellar and a fully equipped Siemens kitchen — offers every comfort a large family or group of friends could ask for. 
Santa Eulalia's restaurants and the wild northern beaches are both within easy reach, yet once inside these walls, the outside world recedes gracefully. Picture an unhurried morning: coffee in the sun-warmed courtyard, the hills of San Lorenzo perfectly still, nowhere you need to be.

The expansive living space invites you to unwind and socialize in an atmosphere of opulence, while the state-of-the-art 'Miele' kitchen stands ready to inspire culinary masterpieces.

Outside, the allure continues with a heated pool beckoning you to relax and rejuvenate amidst the lush surroundings. Dine al fresco under the stars, savoring delectable meals prepared in the open air kitchen, or challenge yourself with a workout session using the dedicated Crossfit Rack, ensuring your stay is as invigorating as it is indulgent.

For moments of pure bliss, retreat to the spa where you can indulge in a range of luxurious treatments, or simply immerse yourself in the tranquility of Ibiza's natural beauty. Nestled in the picturesque southwest of Ibiza, the vibrant area of San Jose awaits exploration. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of San Jose, where charming cafes, boutiques, and galleries await your discovery.

As the day fades into night, experience the vibrant energy of Ibiza's nightlife scene, or simply bask in the tranquility of your private oasis. Your ultimate retreat awaits amidst the newly upgraded outdoor space of Ibiza Island.

name: Can Josie
tagline: A chic bohemian property close to Ibiza’s most beautiful beaches
summary: Can Josie is an exquisitely designed 6 bedroom villa located within a short few minutes to the bay of Cala Jondal home to the famed Blue Marlin Beach Club. Set in the hill of San Jose, you can enjoy spectacular sea…
description: Can Josie is an exquisitely designed 6 bedroom villa located within a short few minutes to the bay of Cala Jondal home to the famed Blue Marlin Beach Club. Set in the hill of San Jose, you can enjoy spectacular sea views and the surrounding countryside.

The interiors have mastered a ethnic boho-chic style that offers plenty of spacious yet welcoming open plan living spaces and direct access to an exterior terrace from where you can enjoy the spectacular sea views. Authentic stone masonry blends seamlessly with Balinese wall hangings creating an eclectic ambiance. This stylish property combines a truly authentic Mediterranean feel with touches of the Far East making it an inspiring holiday home. Furnished throughout to a supremely stylish standard, you will find opulent decorations and artworks to complement the theme of this unique villa.

Can Josie is distributed over three levels with the master bedroom having its own private roof terrace, 2 further double bedrooms in the main villa, and the latter 3 located on the lower floor with their own private access.

The property is ideally settled among well maintained and lush gardens with a child-friendly swimming pool, a large terrace with chill out beds and sun loungers. The exteriors also offer a fully lit tennis court for those who wish to maintain their fitness levels whilst holidaying in Ibiza. The outside dining area and BBQ space is perfect for entertaining, taking you easily from breakfast through to starlit dinners as you soak up the unforgettable sea views.

name: Can Nemo
tagline: Ibiza’s most iconic super villa with unparalleled service
summary: Ibiza’s most iconic super villa, Can Nemo is a masterpiece of modern design, complete with 6-bedroom and 5 bathrooms, an estate set over sprawling acres of lush green gardens.
description: Ibiza’s most iconic super villa, Can Nemo is a masterpiece of modern design, complete with 6-bedroom and 5 bathrooms, an estate set over sprawling acres of lush green gardens.

Located in the exclusive area of Cap Martinet, with majestic sweeping sea views extending to Formentera, the idyllic situation offers easy access to the capital Ibiza Town and many other desirable locations and is just 450m from the sea.

Contemporary design combined with unrivalled views and an abundance of space, plus guaranteed privacy and exceptional service make this the most enchanting villa on the island Can Nemo encapsulates the very essence of Ibiza’s magical spirit.

Indoor Living
As you enter the house via the elegant courtyard, you cannot help but be instantly enchanted by the abundance of space and natural light which floods each room, all of which are designed from the heart, with contemporary class and luxury at every turn.

Each and every living space within the exquisitely designed house offers complete comfort with opulent touches. With the highest quality soft furnishings, fabrics and artwork, plus state-of-the-art smart home technology, you cannot help but let the spirit of the house embrace and enchant you.

An air of elegance abounds throughout each space, inviting you to enjoy the carefully created vibe, whilst an abundance of perfectly primed chill out areas are just begging to be enjoyed. Enjoy the spectacular sea views from the comfort of the living spaces, which are flooded with natural light

Entering the sleeping areas instantly brings a sense of relaxation and calm. With each one as equally enchanting as the next, the bedrooms provide your very own oasis, offering privacy, space and complete comfort, combined with contemporary chic and luxury throughout.

Each suite benefits from personal aircon systems, Wi-Fi, blackout blinds and smart home technology giving complete control of lighting and ambience, amd is complete with a 2 x 2m bed for your comfort.

The Main Suite
The Main Suite is the largest of all the bedroom suites and boasts a Hollywood style dressing room, private sun terrace and freestanding bathtub from where you can enjoy the sumptuous sea views.

Master suite 2
Located separately from the main house. This master suite rivals the main suite in the property. Comprising beautiful decorations and furniture, this suite has stunning views that sweep down over the lush lawn towards the stunning waters of Ibiza.
With large windows and elegant design, it is easy to see why this room is considered the second master.

Suite 1
Mirrored walls add an essence of extra space in this contemporary chic double room offering views over the pool and the sea with direct access to the sun terraces and a large en-suite shower room plus ample storage space.

Suite 2
Another masterpiece of modern design, the monochrome furnishings are elegant and guests can relax and soak up the views, or walk directly out to the pool and gardens from this welcoming space. Complete with an en-suite bathroom.

Suite 3
Flooded with natural sunlight, and the same flow of subtle yet stylish design, this room also offers an en-suite shower room, extensive sea views and is a most delightful, spacious and bright place to rest and relax.

Suite 4
Located inside the main house, guests can also enjoy the sea view from the carefully designed room, which shares a large bathroom with the adjacent room, making it ideal for families or those travelling with children.
Step outside and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of your surroundings from the comfort of the several sun terraces, and soak up the unrivalled sea views.

Breathe in the scent of the perfectly manicured gardens from one of the many chill out areas, providing both sun and shade. Dive deep into the large rectangular pool and soak up the healing rays of the Ibizan sunshine from the luxurious loungers.

The sublime sea views and unforgettable vistas across the skyline and sea will stay with you for a lifetime. Peace and Privacy is assured as the expansive grounds offer space for all guests to enjoy at their leisure.
Dining and Entertaining

We take dining seriously at Can Nemo. Both our indoor and outdoor dining areas have been designed to accommodate you and your guests, seating up to 22 people in comfort and luxury, taking great care to ensure your mealtimes are always memorable
Designed personally by Jose, our head chef to enhance every sitting, our kitchens are perfectly prepared to take you seamlessly from sun kissed breakfasts to starlit dinners, and our bespoke bar areas provide the perfect place to enjoy sun downers with your guests.
Providing the perfect place to eat throughout the year, our dining areas are welcoming and spacious, meaning you always have the right place whatever the occasion. Indulge your senses and choose your favorite tipple whenever it suits you, all the while soaking up the views over the shoreline.
Fitness & Spa
Maintain your physical prime with our state-of-the-art Peloton machines, free weights and fitness technology to be found in the bespoke gymnasium.

A tranquil treatment room provides a space for whatever your heart desires, with a team of wellness available on request to offer every kind of treatment you could wish for.
The dedicated yoga deck offers the perfect place to practice your yoga poses and maintain your daily practice whilst on your holiday.
Can Nemo is now allowing weddings - events of up to 30 guests during April, May, June, September and October with a supplement of 10,000€ for the gathering that covers bar staff and night security.
Wedding duration us for a minimum of 1 week and must comply with local noise regulations and respect to the surrounding neighborhood
Can Nemo includes 6 staff with 48 hours per week, 6 days Villa Manager, 2 Cleaners, Gardener, and villa maintenance caretaker.

Multifunction room.
The Multifunction room of Villa Can Nemo is available for guests to watch movies or play play play station.

Security:
Villa Can Nemo does not have security personnel, if the client requires this service we can arrange it, the cost being borne by the client.

name: Can Nora

description: Elegantly restored farmhouse conveniently located in the rural heart of the island, just a short walk to the village of Santa Gertrudis, a vibrant and popular place full of lively bars, cafes and excellent restaurants. The 600-year-old Hacienda offers a truly authentic Ibiza experience and is set in a large olive plantation and surrounded by green mountains.

Contemporary interiors enliven and compliment this magnificent 600 year-old historic house. A truly unique and authentic property infused with history and Ibicenca tradition, artfully complemented by spectacular interior design features. The spacious lounge and living areas are flooded with natural light and all benefit from charming furnishings, decoration and sophisticated style. The rooms are set out to ensure that everyone has privacy. The sprawling estate offers a true sense of space and freedom.

Each of the 6 bedrooms are equally stylish and furnished to the same exceptional standard. Effortless elegance abounds throughout this charming home, and you will find your every creature comfort catered for. The lounge area offers a reading selection and is served by a traditional style well appointed kitchen.

Step outside into the lavish grounds of Can Nora and enjoy the beautiful vista from the glorious pool or hide yourself away in one of the secluded outdoor chill out areas. The property has excellent facilities for hosting large events, including a spacious and beautifully designed patio with the adjoining barn, which has been converted as a space to host celebrations and events. Expansive, fragrant gardens are blooming with ancient trees, cactuses and flowers.

description: Can Octavia is a 6 bedroom traditional finca which has been lovingly restored and transformed into a captivating home, retaining all of its authenticity and charm, yet refurbished to ensure that your every luxury and comfort is catered for. Situated in the heart of the lush green countryside of San Lorenzo, the location offers easy access to the beautiful beaches of the North, including Benirras, Cala Xarraca and Portinatx. Located only a short drive from the capital, Ibiza Town with its dazzling array of dancing and dining destinations.

Each room within Can Octavia exudes local style and charm, with whitewashed walls and traditional features such as stone mason walls being perfectly complemented by Bohemian chic style furnishings and decorations. The interior design is exceptional with careful attention to detail throughout. The welcoming living room is complete with an open fireplace and flooded with natural light, and is served by a stylish and well appointed kitchen. There are several places to relax and reflect within this charming home.
The 6 bedrooms are all decorated as the living areas, with beautiful furnishings throughout and you will find your every need catered for in all of the sleeping and bathroom areas.
Main house – 3 bedrooms, 4 bathroom, Living room, Dinning room, Bar, Kitchen
Side house – 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Living room, Dinning room, Kitchen
Annex – 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Living room, separate Entrance
Pool house – 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Living room, separate Entrance

Step outside into the gardens of Can Octavia and immerse yourself in the beauty of the nature which surrounds, you, the gardens are perfectly landscaped and full of fragrant flowers and plants, with an inviting pool surrounded by various sun terraces and an alfresco shaded dining area which takes you from breakfast to starlit dinners easily. A private tennis court is available for those who like to remain active whilst holidaying in this most romantic of homes.
The owners prefer families rather than groups of friends.

name: Can Xarraca
tagline: Divine villa surrounded by pine forests in the North of Ibiza
summary: Can Xarraca is a spectacular hideaway with breathtaking sea views, lush private gardens and direct access to the beach. The property is situated near the village of Portinax and consists of 2 separate living areas…
description: Can Xarraca is a spectacular hideaway with breathtaking sea views, lush private gardens and direct access to the beach. The property is situated near the village of Portinax and consists of 2 separate living areas divided by a covered courtyard.

The more recently-build part was designed by the famous Blakstad and consists of the main living room with high beamed ceilings, fireplace and comfortable sofas. French doors open on the terrace overlooking the sea and on the other side to the Moroccan courtyard garden.   Double doors at end of the living room lead to a central hall, the kitchen and the bedrooms. The master suite is located on the first floor, with a four-poster bed and a large private terrace with a fountain and views to the sea and coastal cliffs. There are two more bedrooms, a double and a twin bedroom, located on the ground floor that share a bathroom and have French doors opening to another terrace.

There is a dining area adjoining the kitchen but during the warmer months meals are usually taken outside on the terrace next to the Moroccan garden which is planted with formal box hedges and herbs. There are several other terraces at various spots around the house and gardens.

The second house is a centuries-old finca with beautiful Sabina wood ceilings and many preserved original features. On the ground floor there is a double bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, a twin bedroom, a second kitchen and a small sitting area with a fireplace. Upstairs, there is a double room with a private terrace facing the sea.   Next to the main house there is a large lawn dominated by two enormous palm trees and the 10 metre swimming pool, at the far end of which is a large chill-out area with lots of comfortable cushions and a canvas sunshade.
The house is air-conditioned and there is central heating for the cooler months. There is wireless Internet, satellite TV and a high-spec music system.

Access to the property from the coast road is via a remotely-controlled gate and the grounds extend right down to the seashore – it’s about 800 metres walk down to the pebble beach at Cala Xuclar or 1km to the sandy beach at Cala Xarraca. There is a private parking area with space for several vehicles.
Suitable for weddings & events. Events fee apply.

description: Casa Yolanda is a luxurious Ibiza rental villa with incredible views from its lavish terrace. This exclusive villa is filled with Ibizan charm and has a contemporary yet warm ambience.

This spacious stylishly presented 6-bedroom Ibiza holiday home has a large private pool with plenty of shaded and un-shaded day beds for all the family. There are additional rooms allocated for staff.

Surrounded by lush landscaped gardens where children can play or family and friends can relax, its impressive terrace captures the dazzling Ibiza sun from sunset to sundown. An alfresco dining and barbeque area can easily host up to twelve for guests to while away the evenings soaking up the magnificent views.
Stylishly presented throughout, this prestige Ibiza rental property is perfect for larger families or groups of friends.

This immaculate Ibiza rental holiday home boasts a fully equipped kitchen with all the appliances a family or group of friends could ever need which truly makes it a home from home property. The beautiful rustic feel of the lounge area features an upscale open fireplace for cozy Ibizan evenings or intimate gatherings with soft comfortable seating. All the ground level rooms have the added bonus of opening onto the property’s magnificent terrace.

Each crisp, clean and beautifully presented bedroom has its own bathroom as there are an impressive seven bathrooms in this beautiful Ibiza rental villa. Each include a complimentary hairdryer and towels for guests to use. This is ideal if you are travelling with groups or other families for complete privacy.
Each bathroom include showers with hydro-massage shower heads and/or deep soaking baths, perfect for unwinding after a day in the dazzling sunshine.
Guests can surf the web using the property’s complimentary wireless internet access.

name: Villa Allison
tagline: Stunning property in the most desired area of Ibiza
summary: Villa Allison is a beautifully reformed finca that offers an exceptional blend of rustic charm and modern luxury, perched on a hillside to take full advantage of its expansive views. Guests can savor breathtaking…
description: Villa Allison is a beautifully reformed finca that offers an exceptional blend of rustic charm and modern luxury, perched on a hillside to take full advantage of its expansive views. Guests can savor breathtaking panoramas of the deep blue Mediterranean Sea, the charming silhouette of Dalt Vila (Ibiza's iconic old town), and the rugged hills of nearby Formentera Island. These stunning vistas provide the perfect backdrop for a serene and luxurious escape.

You can enjoy these magnificent views from multiple outdoor spaces throughout the villa. The 10m x 5m saltwater swimming pool is a highlight, providing a refreshing place to relax and take in the surroundings. Whether lounging by the pool on a sunny day or unwinding under the shade of the terrace, you will find the perfect spot to enjoy the views. The shaded terrace features an elegant al-fresco dining area that can comfortably seat up to 14 guests, making it the perfect setting for memorable meals shared with friends and family.

Villa Allison also features an upper terrace, nestled amidst fragrant lavender, where you can enjoy another dining area for 12 guests, alongside comfortable lounge seating, all while taking in even more stunning sea and countryside views. A barbecue and summer kitchen by the poolside add another layer of convenience for outdoor entertaining, creating an ideal space for relaxed meals in the open air.

Inside, the villa offers sleek, minimalist interiors, with an open-plan design that maximizes natural light and seamlessly connects the living areas with the surrounding terraces. The main living space is designed for comfort and style, featuring generous pale sofas arranged to enhance the incredible sea views. The open-plan layout extends into the spacious dining area and well-equipped kitchen, which combines pale wood and cool marble countertops, offering both elegance and functionality for those who enjoy cooking.

For additional relaxation, there’s a second lounge space located downstairs, which opens directly onto the pool terrace. This cozy den includes a home cinema system for movie nights, as well as a small gym for those looking to stay active during their stay.

The villa’s six spacious bedrooms all maintain the same chic aesthetic, with white-walled rooms and polished floors that create a calm and airy ambiance. Each bedroom is en-suite and furnished with a king-size bed, ensuring a comfortable and restful stay. The master suite is particularly luxurious, offering private access to a sun terrace equipped with loungers, where you can enjoy sweeping views of the sea. One of the unique features of Villa Allison is the bedroom distribution whereas only one bedroom offers internal access from the living areas on the ground floor while all of the remain 5 bedrooms offers external entrance to add to the privacy needed when traveling with groups of friends.

Villa Allison is located in a tranquil residential neighborhood, making it an ideal retreat for those seeking peace and privacy. The property is subject to strict noise and loud music regulations between 11 pm and 10 am, ensuring a serene environment for all guests. For families with young children, the villa is well-equipped with a selection of toys, cots, and highchairs to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible.

This fabulous villa is not only a peaceful sanctuary but also perfectly positioned to explore the best of Ibiza. Ibiza Town is less than a ten-minute drive away, offering a wealth of dining, shopping, and cultural experiences. The beautiful golden sands of Playa Talamanca are even closer, providing a perfect spot for beach lovers to enjoy the island's sun, sand, and sea.

Villa Allison is a luxurious retreat with unparalleled sea views and an ideal location for exploring the charms of Ibiza. Whether you are looking to relax by the pool, entertain in the outdoor spaces, or explore the island, this villa offers an unforgettable experience.

Set among the pine-covered hills of San Lorenzo, Villa Amaya occupies a generous private plot where the silence is broken only by birdsong and the distant shimmer of the countryside stretching toward Santa Eulalia. The architecture is clean and considered — sharp lines softened by warm natural materials — with interiors that feel both polished and genuinely liveable. 
Six bedroom suites, all within the main house, are finished to a consistent standard with king-size beds, quality linens, and a calm, uncluttered aesthetic that encourages rest. Living spaces flow naturally toward the outside, where expansive terraces invite long, unhurried meals and the kind of afternoons that blur into evenings without anyone noticing. A fully equipped kitchen handles everything from a quiet breakfast to a full group dinner with ease. 
The mountain views at dusk, all amber and violet, make it very hard to go inside.

name: Villa Brielle
tagline: Recently renovated with amazing sea and sunset views
summary: Villa Brielle is an exceptional and exclusive Ibizan retreat, ideally located close to some of the island’s most desirable sunset beaches on the stunning west coast of Ibiza. This supremely stylish 6-bedroom villa sits…
description: Villa Brielle is an exceptional and exclusive Ibizan retreat, ideally located close to some of the island’s most desirable sunset beaches on the stunning west coast of Ibiza. This supremely stylish 6-bedroom villa sits just a stone's throw away from the pristine white sands of Cala Tarida and Cala Moli, two of the most sought-after beaches in Ibiza, and is only a short drive from the charming village of San Jose. The villa is positioned to take full advantage of breathtaking panoramic views over the sparkling turquoise waters of the Mediterranean Sea and the lush, undulating countryside that defines this part of the island. Offering an unparalleled combination of privacy, luxury, and an enviable location, Villa Brielle is the ultimate destination for those looking to experience the best of Ibiza.

The light-filled interiors of the villa are a true masterpiece, blending modern luxuries and high-tech features with a calming, contemporary style. Designed with impeccable attention to detail, each room is beautifully appointed to create a harmonious environment where guests can unwind and relax. The airy, open-plan living areas flow effortlessly from one space to the next, creating a welcoming atmosphere throughout. The villa is designed to make the most of its stunning natural surroundings, with expansive windows allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the interiors and offering sweeping views of the surrounding landscape. The spacious living and dining areas are perfect for both intimate gatherings and larger groups, while a dedicated breakfast room provides a cozy spot to start the day. The modern, fully equipped kitchen is a chef’s dream, with state-of-the-art appliances and ample space for preparing gourmet meals.

The villa’s tranquil, neutral color palette extends seamlessly into the bedrooms, creating serene retreats for every guest. The main villa’s entrance level is home to the spacious and opulent Master bedroom, which is a true sanctuary. This expansive room boasts not one, but two en-suite bathrooms—one featuring a luxurious shower, the other with a relaxing bathtub—ensuring ultimate comfort and convenience. Adjacent to the Master bedroom is Bedroom 2, a charming twin room, with a sleek shower room just across the hall. Both rooms are flooded with natural light, offering guests a restful environment in which to relax and rejuvenate.

Descending to the lower level, you will find two additional spacious bedrooms—Bedrooms 3 and 4. These double rooms can be configured as either twin beds or double beds (each 90x2) to accommodate different preferences. Both rooms have their own en-suite bathrooms, which include a shower, sink area, and a shared toilet located just over the hall, providing a perfect setup for families or friends traveling together. These bedrooms offer a private and peaceful retreat, complete with ample space and natural light.

In addition to the main villa, Villa Brielle also features two separate annexes, each with its own private entrance. These annexes offer an extra layer of privacy and flexibility, making them ideal for guests seeking a bit more space and independence. Bedrooms 5 and 6 are both comfortable double rooms, which can also be arranged as twin rooms (2 x single beds, each 90x2), and each room comes with its own en-suite bathroom. These annexes provide the perfect escape for guests looking to enjoy a more secluded experience, while still being able to enjoy the luxurious amenities of the main house.

Set within vast, perfectly landscaped grounds, Villa Brielle is surrounded by an array of tropical plants, palm trees, and manicured lawns, creating a serene and private environment. The expansive outdoor spaces offer an abundance of options for relaxation, entertainment, and outdoor living. The highlight of the grounds is the stunning infinity pool, which seems to merge seamlessly with the horizon, offering panoramic views of the sparkling sea and the lush landscape. The villa’s outdoor spaces are designed to maximize comfort and enjoyment, with multiple terraces, shaded lounging areas, and soft-seated chill-out spots scattered throughout the garden. A beautiful sunset-facing al-fresco dining area provides the perfect setting for enjoying meals while taking in the world-renowned Ibizan sunset, one of the island's most iconic and spectacular sights.

Villa Brielle is perfectly positioned to enjoy the captivating beauty of Ibiza’s west coast sunsets. As the sun sets over the horizon, the sky is transformed into a vibrant canvas of colors, creating a magical atmosphere that must be seen to be believed. The villa’s prime location offers guests the unique opportunity to experience this breathtaking natural spectacle from the comfort of their own villa, whether they are lounging by the pool, dining al-fresco, or relaxing in one of the many cozy garden chill-out areas.

From its luxurious interiors to its expansive grounds and stunning views, Villa Brielle offers a truly luxurious setting for those seeking to unwind and indulge in the best of Ibiza. Whether you're spending the day by the pool, enjoying an evening sunset, or simply relaxing in one of the villa’s many peaceful spaces, this exquisite property provides everything you need for an unforgettable holiday experience.

name: Villa Eliana
tagline: Six bedrooms, infinite sky, and Ibiza's most legendary sunsets
summary: Nestled in the pine-scented hills beside the idyllic village of San Agustin, Villa Eliana is an elegant six-bedroom retreat with sweeping views over almond and olive groves to San Antonio Bay and the shimmering…
description: Nestled in the pine-scented hills beside the idyllic village of San Agustin, Villa Eliana is an elegant six-bedroom retreat with sweeping views over almond and olive groves to San Antonio Bay and the shimmering Mediterranean. San José is just five minutes away, and Ibiza Town and the airport are around 20 minutes by car, so the island’s finest beaches, restaurants and beach clubs are always close at hand.

At the heart of the villa lies a magnificent 12m x 4.5m private pool, framed by tall palms, fragrant pines and serene woodland views. Landscaped gardens, secluded terraces and luxurious chill-out areas invite long, languid days in the Mediterranean sun. On the upper terrace, an al fresco dining table for up to 12 guests sets the stage for unforgettable dinners beneath Ibiza’s legendary sunsets and star-filled skies.

Inside, light-filled living spaces combine contemporary elegance with breathtaking views. The lounge opens onto a private balcony with direct access to the pool terrace, while the dining room offers a sophisticated setting for entertaining. A spacious, beautifully equipped kitchen, shaded by a mature pine, completes the living area.

Villa Eliana sleeps up to 12 guests in six bright, stylish bedrooms, many with dreamy views of the sea or countryside. There are two master suites, each with a private en-suite bathroom, and four double bedrooms sharing two sleek, modern bathrooms.
Secluded yet effortlessly connected, Villa Eliana is a sublime choice for families and friends seeking the very best of West Ibiza.

name: Villa Gie
tagline: Moroccan lanterns, pine hills, and the sea at Cala Salada
summary: Villa Georgia is a beautiful newly renovated 6 bedroom villa with an boho-chic fusion of modern and Moroccan styling. This unique family-friendly home is surrounded by staggering views of green pine trees hills and the…
description: Villa Georgia is a beautiful newly renovated 6 bedroom villa with an boho-chic fusion of modern and Moroccan styling. This unique family-friendly home is surrounded by staggering views of green pine trees hills and the sparkling Mediterranean sea and sunset views over the renowned Cala Salada. Just a short drive away and guests will find themselves directly in the centre of San Antonio with its famous nightlife, sunset music bars and restaurants.

This property offers an open plan design throughout its living spaces with an artistic flair and light enhancing windows which offer a large fully equipped kitchen with a dining table, interior cosy corners and a living room - all with luxurious views. All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms with the superb master bedroom comprising a unique feature steam-room. Each bedroom also has its own Bluetooth speaker. The lush, well-maintained grounds of Villa Katherine are a true highlight. Villa Larish truly shines outdoors. The property features several terraces, each designed to capture the Mediterranean sun at different times of the day. summary: The villa is elegantly and luxuriously furnished and equipped. It leaves nothing to be desired for a sophisticated and relaxing holiday.
description: The villa is elegantly and luxuriously furnished and equipped. It leaves nothing to be desired for a sophisticated and relaxing holiday.

It has a beautiful and enchanting distant view of the harbour and the sea. There is sun on the terraces all day long and the evenings have wonderful light shows of the sky and beautiful sunsets. And the city lights illuminate the sky until late at night.
Equipped with 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Two bedrooms are on the upper floor, the master bedroom and another one on the lower floor with living room, kitchen and direct access to the terrace.
Separate apartment with a small kitchen and bathroom, which is perfect for additional guests or a nanny.
BBQ area, pool overlooking the bay of St. Antonio. There are various chill-out areas and retreats.
Perfect for a large group of friends or family
It’s full equipped with security system, barbecue, big cared garden, carport, electric gate, Wlan, fireplace.

name: Can Chloe
tagline: Stunning property with beautiful sea views
summary: Perched above the glittering western coastline, Can Chloe sits within easy reach of two of Ibizas most quietly coveted coves, the sheltered bay of Cala Vadella and the pebbled shore of Cala Moli. Inside, white walls and…
description: Perched above the glittering western coastline, Can Chloe sits within easy reach of two of Ibizas most quietly coveted coves, the sheltered bay of Cala Vadella and the pebbled shore of Cala Moli. Inside, white walls and natural wood set a calm, unhurried tone, while colourful furnishings add warmth and character to the generous living spaces. The kitchen is well equipped and anchored by a breakfast bar, opens onto a sunwashed terrace where a table for eight catches the morning light. As the day turns, the villas elevated position earns its reputation: the western horizon ignites at sunset, painting the sea amber and gold. With five bedrooms and an atmosphere that sits somewhere between refined and relaxed, this is a villa for those who want Ibizas wild beauty on their own terms unhurried, uninterrupted and entirely their own.

name: Can Daphne
tagline: Renovated finca in a tranquil Santa Gertrudis
summary: Finca Can Daphne belongs to the absolute top segment fincas of Ibiza. This more than 250-year-old 5 bedroom family finca plus separate guest house and old tower was completely renovated during 2018 and 2019. With a nod…
description: Finca Can Daphne belongs to the absolute top segment fincas of Ibiza. This more than 250-year-old 5 bedroom family finca plus separate guest house and old tower was completely renovated during 2018 and 2019. With a nod to the famous Blackstad fincas, in combination with its own character, it has become a real gem.

Can Daphne is offering an amazing dazzling stay with all new bedrooms, new bathrooms, new kitchens, new floors, new terraces, new salt-electrolysis pool (5x10 meters) (10% salt content), a new chill-out ´corner´ with a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, a yoga deck, kids playground with trampoline and table tennis, child-safety terraces around the pool, a games room with pool table and so on.

Also, you will find the latest technical gadgets in the field of sound and the internet. There is also a laundry room for you as a guest and you will find air conditioning in the majority of rooms. There are idyllic views, looking out over the beautiful valleys with a large variety of fruit trees, various large terraces with different dining areas, and various chill-out zones.

The main house accommodates 8 people, the nearby guesthouse with the tower provides room for two more.
From the garden, you walk into the main house. There is a beautiful fully equipped open kitchen. The living room is very cozy. Next to the living room, there is another lounge where you'll find a pool table. On the ground floor, there are 2 bedrooms. One of the bedrooms has en-suite bathroom with a shower. The other bathroom, also with shower, which belongs to the second bedroom is adjacent to the living room and also functions as a guest toilet.

The first floor can be reached via the amazing spiral staircase. Here is the master bedroom. On the private terrace of the master bedroom you will find a bath and shower. Adjacent to the hall is another bathroom with a bath and shower, this belongs also to the master bedroom. The other bedroom that is located here has an en-suite bathroom with a shower.
The guest house is situated in the tower. It has a sitting area and a small open kitchen, the washing mashing machine can also be found here.

Can Daphne is located 20 minutes drive from the airport in the heart of the island just 4 minutes from the beautiful and increasingly in-demand art village of Santa Gertrudis. The Finca can be found at the end of a winding camino, meaning there is no passing traffic and 100% privacy and peace are guaranteed. Within only 10 minutes you can be in Ibiza town or at one of the popular beaches and beach clubs.

name: Can Elsa
tagline: A whitewashed finca where countryside silence with sea views
summary: Can Elsa is a charming and traditional Ibicencan 5-bedroom villa, ideally located just moments from the stunning bays of Cala Bassa and Cala Conta, both renowned for their crystal-clear waters and breathtaking sunset…
description: Can Elsa is a charming and traditional Ibicencan 5-bedroom villa, ideally located just moments from the stunning bays of Cala Bassa and Cala Conta, both renowned for their crystal-clear waters and breathtaking sunset views. Only a short drive away from the quaint and picturesque village of San Agustin, this exquisite property is set on a generous plot of land, surrounded by sweeping green countryside, offering guests the ultimate blend of privacy and natural beauty.

The interiors of Can Elsa elegantly maintain the iconic 'Ibicenco' style, featuring traditional elements such as floor-to-ceiling stone masoned walls and wooden beamed ceilings that infuse the villa with authentic charm. These classic details are artfully complemented by striking bright white finishes and modern decor, creating a perfect balance between rustic tradition and contemporary luxury. The open-plan design offers an inviting and spacious lounge area with a large, comfortable sofa, providing a cozy spot for relaxation. A choice of dining areas makes it easy to enjoy both formal meals and more casual dining experiences. The stylish, fully equipped modern kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring a breakfast bar and all the latest appliances, ensuring a seamless experience for both seasoned chefs and those who prefer to enjoy leisurely meals. Contemporary lighting, artwork, and stylish furniture throughout the villa contribute to the sophisticated atmosphere, blending traditional design with modern touches.

Each of the five bedrooms is spacious and thoughtfully designed, maintaining the villa’s seamless theme of contemporary elegance. The bedrooms are all beautifully decorated, with a clean and modern aesthetic that flows naturally from the rest of the villa. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom, ensuring privacy and convenience for all guests. The Master bedroom is located on the upper grounds of the property and features its own private entrance, as well as a large terrace where you can enjoy stunning views of the surrounding countryside and coastline. Bedroom 2 also has its own private entrance, a comfortable double bed, and an en-suite bathroom, offering an additional level of privacy. Bedrooms 3, 4, and 5 are located within the main finca and are equally spacious and beautifully designed, each with an en-suite bathroom, and one bedroom having a WC just over the hall for added convenience.

The exterior of Can Elsa is centered around a delightful pool area, which is surrounded by high-quality decking, sun loungers, and parasols, making it the perfect spot for soaking up the Ibizan sun. The pool area is complemented by several dining spaces, ranging from formal seating to more relaxed, bohemian-style outdoor dining. Whether you prefer a laid-back meal in the shade or a more elegant evening under the stars, there is an ideal setting for every occasion. Two luxurious chill-out areas are also available for guests to unwind in comfort. One of these areas offers a shaded space with a view of the pool, while the other is a sun-drenched roof terrace, providing panoramic views of the stunning surroundings.
With its blend of traditional charm and modern sophistication, Can Elsa is a perfect retreat for those seeking a luxurious escape in one of Ibiza’s most desirable locations.

name: Can Luna
tagline: An exceptional property in a family friendly location
summary: Can Luna is a luxurious and charming 5 bedroom villa with exceptional seaviews located just a few metres from the nearest beach. Close by is the elegant Nikki Beach club and the area of S’Argamassa with its seafront…
description: Can Luna is a luxurious and charming 5 bedroom villa with exceptional seaviews located just a few metres from the nearest beach. Close by is the elegant Nikki Beach club and the area of S’Argamassa with its seafront bars and restaurants. The vibrant town of Santa Eulalia is just a short drive away, with its abundance of dining destinations, shops and amenities, making this a desirable location for families.

The interior decor has a fluid theme of a contemporary minimalist approach artfully combined with authentic Mediterranean decor throughout the open-plan lounge area and modern kitchen, which is of course fully equipped with all modern appliances. There are 5 beautifully furnished double bedrooms all with en-suite bathrooms, ample wardrobe space and air conditioning. Each bedroom has its own individual charm, with bright colourful artwork complementing the neutral tones of the decor. Head upstairs and enjoy the delights of the sun-drenched roof terrace with expansive and tranquil sea views.

The property is a modern architectural build with a traditional Ibizan style, predominantly white exterior walls with beautiful planes of stone masonry works. The grounds are spacious and inviting, the perfect place to spend a lazy luxurious Ibizan afternoon, with a unique L-shape swimming pool with an expansive terrace and sunbathing area complete with several sun loungers. You can entertain friends and family at your leisure in the outdoor dining and entertaining space with a purpose built BBQ. Can Luna is an exceptional frontline property in a family friendly location.

name: Can Mira
tagline: Charming and stylish Villa near San Lorenzo and Santa Gertrudis
summary: Can Mira is a five bedroom villa, newly built stone by stone within the magical embrace of ancient pine trees and a forest that holds secrets only those with an open-heart and unfettered imagination can uncover.…
description: Can Mira is a five bedroom villa, newly built stone by stone within the magical embrace of ancient pine trees and a forest that holds secrets only those with an open-heart and unfettered imagination can uncover. Perfectly hidden deep in the campo, its proximity to restaurants, beaches, shops and Ibiza town are to be rejoiced in; nothing is far from your Island hideaway. Follow the twisting country roads and within minutes you find yourself in the village of Santa Gertrudis, a cool cute social hub, where stocking up on organic essentials, popping in to browse artisan home wares in Es Cucones or an indulgent no shame people watching, café con leche in hand from the village square are all easy peasey.

A love project from beginning to end, the villa is everything you would want from a family villa. Soft muted natural stone interiors provide the backdrop for mystical artifacts and artwork from far flung destinations all personally curated by the owners. High spec throughout, Can Mira makes the living easy and frankly effortless when you have a multi generational group that lovingly demand different things. Yet it is more than just the city standard flick of a button technology here that eases your time on the island. Sun shiny days that make way to hazy nights, giggles and stolen glances between your tribe, knowing that all is right, all is good. Dancing like a loon just to see your children laugh uncontrollably, their beautiful faces etched into your mind's memory bank forever. With a myriad of outside al fresco spaces and a huge garden perfect for tearing around in, Can Mirna will return you and your loved ones to the connection that is sometimes lost in our busy lives. Restoring fun, frivolity and freedom, all by just holding the most precious of spaces for you all to simply be.

Open plan living creates space and intimacy all in one and Can Miras’ large living, dining and kitchen area provide this new slow rhythm for you to languidly dance to. Carefully considered cupboards and generous amounts of work surfaces including a central food island implore you to prepare nutritious and fun family feasts. Large windows look out onto the wisteria-framed porch, and beyond the forest unfurls its majesty. Keep a watchful eye on your little ones as they begin adventures in the forest, returning at lunchtime a little more feral than they started. The look of exploration ablaze in their shiny, excited eyes.

A large L-shaped sofa with super snugly seats invites you and your lot to cuddle on or stretch out. Planning the day's island adventures or perhaps radically not planning at all, delighting in the newly found sense of no schedule.

Can Mirna offers a myriad of activities for your young ones to engage in, from skateboarding, football or badminton whilst you lounge in any of the chill out or al fresco dining spaces. Cocooned by nature, Can Mirna offers freedom and space to roam wildly. Proud Pines leave traces of a resinous woody smell in the air and Palms of all sizes from stocky to slender cast a tropical spell that weaves around you. Breaking the fifty shades of verdant green are neon burst of saturated fuchsia bougainvillea. Precisely cut green coiffured lawns offer their soft-carpeted grass for bare foot walks or take off like an explored and follow the windy paths deep into the grounds.
For cozy fireside chats, curl around the open plan fire when the nip is in the air or simply luxuriate alone in the space with a book or guilty pleasure magazine.

Mainhouse: 4 Bedrooms and 3 Bathrooms
Guesthouse: 1 Bedroom with 1 bathroom

San Lorenzo 4km
Santa Gertrudis 5,5km
Santa Eulalia 6,5km
Supermaket 4km
Ibiza Stadt 12km
Airport 18km

Large open plan living area with fireplace, L-shaped sofa & opens onto the terrace
Open plan dining area opening onto the terrace
Fully equipped open plan kitchen with work island
Master bedroom (double) with sitting room opening onto terrace
Bedroom 2 (double) opening onto balcony
Bedroom 3 (french double) with en-suite (shower)
Bedroom 4 (french double) with en-suite (shower)
Bathroom for master bedroom & bedroom 2 (bath & shower)
The owners prefer families rather than groups of friends. Up to 6 adults and 4 kids are the ideal group - max 8 adults.

name: Can Savasana
tagline: A 16th-Century Finca, Private Cala Salada Access, Zero Compromise
summary: From its lofty perch in the quiet pine-clad hills near San Antonio, Savasana holiday villa enjoys spectacular sea views and grand Ibiza sunsets. The 50 000 m2 grounds surrounding the villa provide countless vantage…
description: From its lofty perch in the quiet pine-clad hills near San Antonio, Savasana holiday villa enjoys spectacular sea views and grand Ibiza sunsets. The 50 000 m2 grounds surrounding the villa provide countless vantage points for reflection, and include a pool, multiple relaxing and outdoor dining areas and both a Mediterranean and vegetable garden - all enjoyed in the perfect privacy of the neighbourless plot.

The villa itself is unique - a 500 year old finca restored in high quality, with modern comforts but a decidedly rustic, homely and creative style which includes Balinese fittings, tiles, unusual artworks and artefacts and beautiful wooden beams.

With 5 double bedrooms - 3 of which en suite making a total of 4 bathrooms - there is space enough for up to 10 people in either groups or families. For the safety of children the very large pool can be fenced on request. This villa is also ideal for weddings, with the top floor master bedroom including a 100 m² private terrace with the best sea views on the whole plot.

Savasana is not far from the action, but its secluded location make a car essential. The nearest beach is the beautiful Cala Salada, only a 5 minute drive, whilst San Antonio and its shops, clubs and famous sunset strip cafes are only 10 minutes.

name: Can Vista Cala Jondal
tagline: Exquisite contemporary villa in the exclusive area of Cala Jondal.
summary: This beautifully refurbished property offers a prime location, just moments from the iconic Blue Marlin, and combines modern luxury with serene privacy.
description: This beautifully refurbished property offers a prime location, just moments from the iconic Blue Marlin, and combines modern luxury with serene privacy.

The villa spans 400m² and is set on a fully enclosed 5,200m² plot with stunning sea views. The landscaped garden is a tranquil haven, featuring a lush green lawn, palm trees, olive trees, and other Mediterranean plants. At the center is a luxurious 5 x 12m pool, perfect for soaking up the Ibiza sunshine.

The villa is thoughtfully designed across two levels. On the ground floor, you’ll find a spacious living area, an open-plan fully equipped kitchen, a guest bathroom, a twin bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, and a master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom. Both bedrooms provide direct access to the garden, blending indoor and outdoor living seamlessly. Upstairs, there are two more en-suite bedrooms and a large terrace with breathtaking sea views, which also connects to the garden. All rooms feature air conditioning, and the villa’s micro-cement flooring enhances its sleek, contemporary aesthetic. Additionally, a separate stone house (casita) with en-suite bedrooms and a kitchen complements the main property.

For those seeking wellness and activity, the villa includes a brand-new, fully equipped gym powered by Technogym®, conveniently located beneath the pool. Guests are welcome to use and enjoy this premium facility.
With its unbeatable location and top-tier amenities, this modern villa in Cala Jondal offers the perfect setting for an unforgettable Ibiza getaway.

name: Puesta del Sol
tagline: Stylish 5 bedrooms chalet with a spectacular sea view on the West cost
summary: Enjoy a wonderful vacation in this luxurious and cosy chalet located in a very quiet area in Cala Salada. You can enjoy the beautiful views of the sea and the small islands of Cala Compte from the swimming pool, the…
description: Enjoy a wonderful vacation in this luxurious and cosy chalet located in a very quiet area in Cala Salada. You can enjoy the beautiful views of the sea and the small islands of Cala Compte from the swimming pool, the terraces, the living room, the kitchen, and the master bedroom. In front of the living room of the main house there is a covered terrace with a dining area for al fresco dining and an elegant seating area for chill out. Behind the garden there is another stylish pergola that offers another wonderful place for relaxation. The spectacular 12 x 5 swimming pool with Roman steps is surrounded by a wooden solarium. Throughout the garden you can enjoy with all tranquillity and privacy the wonderful views of the Mediterranean Sea. The interior is modern and new and offers all the comforts. The bright living room has a huge sliding glass door through which you can enjoy the spectacular of Cala Salada. The main house has three bedrooms and then there are two guest bedrooms with a private entrance, their own terrace, and a seating area under the comfortable shade of trees.
Cala Salada beach is 1 minute drive away and others such as Cala Gració and Cala Gracioneta, just 5 minutes drive away.
San Antonio is the closest town but San Josep and San Rafael are also not far away.

name: Villa Can Gertrudis
tagline: Boutique Style villa with a 11m x 4m pool close to the town of Santa Gertrudis
summary: "The owners prefer families rather than groups of friends"
description: "The owners prefer families rather than groups of friends"
Villa Can Gertrudis is a modern holiday villa located in the heart of the island near Santa Gertrudis. Furnished with exclusive furniture, this family-friendly holiday home is in prime condition.

Villa Can Gertrudis is a perfect, modern summer residence that provides for unbelievable peace. The 15,000m2 property provides for 275m2 living space. Generously sized windows invite lots of natural light into the rooms. Ibiza City, San Rafael, Santa Gertrudis as well as Santa Eulalia are all less than a 10-minute drive away.

The holiday villa Villa Can Gertrudis comprises two buildings that are connected via a patio. The main house is entered via the extensive lounge style living room that comprises two spaces. The living space has a large dining table and a sofa corner with a fireplace. There’s a LCD satellite television in the sofa corner with a top-quality home cinema system. The very well-equipped kitchen has a large American fridge and direct access to the patio. The main house also has two bedrooms with double bed (2 x 2m x 1.8m) and a shared bathroom with shower / toilet.
The adjacent house, which was finished in 2015, has the large, main bedroom with double bed (2m x 1.8m) with en suite toilet as well as two bedrooms (2 x 2m x 1.8m) and a shower.

Diverse chill out terraces, Balinese beds and lounge corners are ideal for relaxation, sociable get together or BBQs. There is a dining table for 10-12 people on the generously spaced patio with Pergola.

The expansive garden and terrace area is complete with an exclusive pool with lighting, deckchairs, parasols, an outdoor pool, two gazebos, one Zen meditation garden, a playground and a full bathroom next to the pool.

Cleaning service after 7 days (2, 3 or 4 weeks stay)
​
Santa Gertrudis 3 km - San Rafael 5 km - Ibiza Town 11 km - Supermarket 3 km - Airport 17 km
Pool can be heated 350 Euro / week!!

name: Villa Capo
tagline: Monochrome architecture, jewel-toned interiors, Cap Martinet's quietest address
summary: Cap Martinet sits at that rare intersection of seclusion and proximity — five minutes from Ibiza Town's harbour restaurants, yet removed enough that the only sounds at night are cicadas and the occasional lap of the…
description:
Cap Martinet sits at that rare intersection of seclusion and proximity — five minutes from Ibiza Town's harbour restaurants, yet removed enough that the only sounds at night are cicadas and the occasional lap of the pool. 
Villa Capo is a newly built five-bedroom home that wears its modernity with confidence: white render and dark glass on the outside, jewel-toned velvets and playful colour accents within. The contrast is deliberate and it works. Natural light floods the open-plan living spaces throughout the day, shifting from sharp morning clarity to warm amber by early evening. The five bedrooms are arranged across two floors — a layout that creates a genuine sense of privacy even when the villa is full. The master suite opens directly onto the terrace and pool through floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, while two further double rooms each have their own en-suite bathrooms. 
Pull back the doors on your first morning and let Ibiza come to you.

name: Villa Diso
tagline: Beautiful property close to the beach
summary: Cozy 4-bedroom house with one seperate bedroom is within walking distance to the beach. This beautiful villa offers stunning sea views and incredible sunsets. From the moment you step through the door, you’ll feel at…
description: Cozy 4-bedroom house with one seperate bedroom is within walking distance to the beach. This beautiful villa offers stunning sea views and incredible sunsets. From the moment you step through the door, you’ll feel at home with its cozy design and thoughtful attention to detail – this is not just another house, but a real home in a fantastic location.

The villa accommodates up to 8 guests with 4 bedrooms in the main house and an additional independent bedroom that can be used for staff. The interior features a spacious living area with large sliding doors that open to the pool area, offering breathtaking sea views and sunsets. The fully equipped open kitchen provides everything you need for a comfortable stay.

The bedrooms are thoughtfully arranged: Bedroom 1 has a double bed and en-suite bathroom with a shower. Bedroom 2 offers twin beds that can be joined, access to a covered terrace, and an attached bathroom with a shower. Bedroom 3 features a double bed, an en-suite bathroom with a shower, and access to the pool terrace. Bedroom 4 has twin beds that can be joined, an en-suite bathroom with a shower, and a private entrance from the pool terrace. Bedroom 5, located in the basement with independent access, includes a double bed and an external bathroom. This room is ideal as a spare bedroom or nanny room, as it does not match the same standard as the others.

The exterior boasts a welcoming Mediterranean garden with vibrant colors and several chill-out areas, perfect for socializing with family and friends or enjoying some quiet time alone. The garden features a large pool with sunbeds, an outdoor covered dining area with a barbecue, and a spacious table for everyone to gather and enjoy local specialties.

The villa is conveniently located within walking distance of Cala Vadella beach (150 meters), which is ideal for families and offers several restaurants, shops, and a supermarket. Parking is available on the public street, approximately 50 meters from the house.
Please note: The 5th bedroom has an external bathroom.

name: Villa Marielle
tagline: A breathtaking property featuring expansive and impeccably designed outdoor living spaces
summary: Villa Marielle is an exclusive 5-bedroom private residence defined by its refined design and quiet elegance. Set in a secluded location between the village of San José and the iconic bay of Cala Jondal—home to some of…
description: Villa Marielle is an exclusive 5-bedroom private residence defined by its refined design and quiet elegance. Set in a secluded location between the village of San José and the iconic bay of Cala Jondal—home to some of Ibiza’s most sought-after beach destinations—the villa offers both privacy and proximity.

Inside, contemporary design is balanced with natural warmth. Polished wood floors and carefully selected furnishings create a calm and inviting atmosphere, enhanced by natural light throughout. Each of the five bedrooms features its own en-suite bathroom, finished with high-quality materials and a clean, modern aesthetic.
The master suite is designed as a private retreat, complete with shower, bathtub, hammam, and direct access to a secluded Jacuzzi and chill-out area.

Surrounded by landscaped gardens of mature palms and pine trees, the outdoor areas are designed for both relaxation and entertaining. At the center of the property sits a striking infinity pool, complemented by a private padel court, pétanque pitch, outdoor cinema, and curated garden spaces.

Expansive terraces offer multiple lounge areas, an al fresco dining space, and a second shaded lounge set within a beach-style setting. A fully equipped outdoor bar with seating for up to 30 guests creates a natural focal point for hosting and social gatherings.
Villa Marielle is ideal for smaller groups seeking a private, design-led property with strong outdoor living and easy access to Cala Jondal.

name: Villa Nia
tagline: A stunning property located close to Cala Jondal
summary: Villa Nia is a uniquely designed 5 bedroom property perfectly situated in one of the most desirable areas of Ibiza, and offers spectacular views over Cala Jondal, the sparkling Mediterranean sea and the surrounding…
description: Villa Nia is a uniquely designed 5 bedroom property perfectly situated in one of the most desirable areas of Ibiza, and offers spectacular views over Cala Jondal, the sparkling Mediterranean sea and the surrounding countryside and coastline landscape.

Upon entering this modern, minimalist style home, the spacious hall leads into the large and tastefully decorated living room which is flooded with the glorious Ibizan sunlight through floor to ceiling sliding glass doors which emphasis the full effect of the unrivaled sea views. Careful attention has been paid to every detail for your comfort and luxury and tasteful decoration abounds throughout every part of this sophisticated villa.

A modern fully equipped kitchen offers you the option to extend out onto the outdoor covered terrace and al fresco dining area for entertaining, or alternatively set a more formal evening scene for your guests in the large interior dining room located in an adjacent and open plan style to the stylish kitchen. Villa Nia offers clean and bright contemporary interiors throughout which is enhanced with neutral and well chosen decor. All bedrooms are luxuriously furnished with en-suite or connecting bathrooms and some have access to their owner private terrace.

Step outside and spend a long lazy day soaking up the healing rays of the Ibizan sunshine around the fabulous pool area, which is surrounded by ample luxurious sun loungers, with a large outdoor dining area complete with BBQ and an incredibly inviting and comfortable shaded chill-out area providing an ideal space to truly appreciate the sea views, relax and reflect after another idyllic day.
Villa Nia also offers a full size tennis court just meters from the main house ideal for sport oriented holiday makers or for anyone who wishes to fine tune any long lost skills.

name: Villa Paola
tagline: An elegant and stylish villa close to Cala Jondal
summary: Villa Paola is a modern 5 bedroom private property which enjoys an elevated countryside view within walking distance to Cala Jondal beach, home to the renowned and exclusive Blue Marlin Beach Club. The home is…
description: Villa Paola is a modern 5 bedroom private property which enjoys an elevated countryside view within walking distance to Cala Jondal beach, home to the renowned and exclusive Blue Marlin Beach Club. The home is surrounded by extensive land and lavish gardens. The villa's living areas and bedrooms are split over several levels.

Upon entering Villa Paola, you will delight in the open plan fully equipped kitchen, leading you naturally through to a spacious lounge offering large comfortable sofa seating and an accommodating dining area; all of which have floods of natural light through the floor to ceiling windows and simply unforgettable seaviews. Exquisite attention to detail means that his home is at once welcoming yet sophisticated and opulent, giving a feeling of luxury throughout,

All of the double bedrooms are superbly decorated with the elegant theme flowing through this most stylish of homes. Your every comfort is catered for with state of the art furnishings and decoration, each room has an en-suite bathroom, with the master suite benefiting from its own bath tub and huge terrace and panoramic views from the top of the villa. There is also a private gym available for use.

Of course, the exteriors and grounds of Villa Paola are equally grand, with several terraces on different levels complete with luxurious sun drenched and shaded chill out areas.There is a fabulous infinity pool with several sun loungers as well as four poster day beds for you and your guests to recline and reflect. The beautifully landscape and well maintained grounds and lush, fragrant Mediterranean gardens are home to a stunning Balinese gazebo, purposely designed with al fresco dining in mind. The expansive outdoor space is the perfect place to truly immerse yourself in the spectacular views.

name: Villa Riley
tagline: A stylish modern villa with unforgettable sea views
summary: Villa Riley is a breathtaking 5-bedroom villa located in the prestigious, gated community of Vista Alegre on Ibiza’s idyllic south coast. Perfectly situated to offer unparalleled privacy and tranquility, this…
description: Villa Riley is a breathtaking 5-bedroom villa located in the prestigious, gated community of Vista Alegre on Ibiza’s idyllic south coast. Perfectly situated to offer unparalleled privacy and tranquility, this architectural gem boasts awe-inspiring views across Es Torrent Bay, with sweeping vistas of the sparkling Mediterranean Sea. The villa’s prime location ensures easy access to the secluded coves and pristine white-pebble beaches near Es Cubells, making it a haven for those seeking both serenity and convenience.

Inside, the villa is a study in modern sophistication. The polished white stone floors flow seamlessly throughout, creating a sense of openness and calm. The interiors are tastefully designed with a chic, contemporary style that combines neutral tones, sleek lines, and bespoke artwork. The expansive, light-filled kitchen is a true chef’s dream, equipped with state-of-the-art appliances and a stylish dining area that comfortably accommodates up to ten guests. From here, large sliding glass doors open to an elegant outdoor deck, inviting the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape into the home.

The villa’s thoughtful design ensures that each space is both functional and luxurious. The master suite occupies the entire top floor, offering the ultimate in privacy and comfort. This spacious retreat features a private terrace that provides panoramic sea views, stretching all the way to Formentera, making it the perfect spot to watch the sun set over the horizon. The room is designed with meticulous attention to detail, offering a sanctuary of relaxation. Each of the other four bedrooms is equally opulent, complete with its own en-suite bathroom, offering guests the utmost comfort, privacy, and tranquility.

The exterior of the villa is equally impressive, designed to create a seamless transition from the indoor spaces to the outdoors. The south-facing pool is the focal point of the expansive outdoor area, inviting guests to enjoy the year-round sunshine and stunning surroundings. The beautifully landscaped terraces offer both shaded lounge areas and sun-soaked spaces, ideal for relaxing, dining, or entertaining in complete comfort. The spacious hardwood deck, which spans the full width of the property, is perfect for lounging, enjoying the views, or hosting guests.

Whether you’re lounging by the pool, dining al fresco with friends, or simply soaking in the serene surroundings, Villa Riley provides the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty. With its exquisite design, breathtaking views, and prime location, this villa offers an unforgettable Ibiza experience.

name: Villa Sa Carroca Oasis
tagline: Beautiful villa located in the sought-after area of Sa Carroca
summary: Located in the sought-after area of Sa Carroca, close to all the key services and hotspots of the island, Villa Sa Carroca Oasis is a spacious and comfortable private villa, ideal for families or groups of friends…
description: Located in the sought-after area of Sa Carroca, close to all the key services and hotspots of the island, Villa Sa Carroca Oasis is a spacious and comfortable private villa, ideal for families or groups of friends looking for space, privacy and excellent connectivity.

For cozy fireplace evenings, there is a closed fireplace in the living area.
The sea and Santa Eulalia center are about 5 to 8 minutes walk away.
Ibiza Town, World Culture Heritage, with its many facets, is just 10 minutes away by car.
Enjoy a beautiful stay with family and friends.
Well suited for golf players!
